invariants.rationale: nodes is always used without null checks in the method body.
Array.size is always non-negative by contract.
result is a float representing Y position; float can be any real number, but this captures that method never returns NaN (unless actorY could be NaN).
indent is used in addition operations for UI positioning and is unlikely to be negative.
plusMinusWidth is used for width offsets for drawing icons and is likely non-negative.
